description: A shell script containing a series of tests for git checkout behavior, especially regarding untracked files, directories, symlinks, and overwrite options.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a given description.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the command it runs is expected to fail.

methods.name: test_ln_s_add
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link and adds it to git tracking.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks whether a given path is a file.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
